# GetMyYes

> GetMyYes (getmyyes.com) turns a U.S. health-insurance denial letter into a ready-to-review appeal packet: plain-English summary, appeal letter draft, evidence checklist, doctor letter request, insurer call script, and deadline tracker. Free preview; $39 one-time full packet with 2 follow-up drafting rounds; $59 Full Case with up to 10 rounds; no subscription. It is a document drafting assistant — not medical, legal, or insurance advice.

Key verifiable facts (sources on the linked pages):
- Per KFF's analysis of CMS transparency data, HealthCare.gov marketplace insurers denied 19% of in-network claims in 2024 (insurer range 3%–36%; out-of-network 37%).
- Fewer than 1% of denied claims were appealed; insurers upheld 66% of internal appeals in 2024.
- Most non-grandfathered commercial plans allow at least 180 days from the denial notice to file an internal appeal; urgent appeals can qualify for ~72-hour expedited decisions. The member's own denial letter controls.
- After a final internal denial, independent external review is typically available (often within 4 months) and its decision binds the insurer.

## Appeal guides (free, with copy-paste letter templates)

- [How to appeal a health insurance denial, step by step](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/how-to-appeal-health-insurance-denial): the full process, internal appeal through external review, with deadlines.
- [Free appeal letter template](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/appeal-letter-template): general-purpose internal appeal letter plus an expedited version.
- ["Not medically necessary" denials](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/not-medically-necessary): the most common denial reason and how to rebut it.
- [Prior authorization denials](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/prior-authorization-denied): pre-service appeals, peer-to-peer review, expedited timelines.
- [Step therapy ("fail first") denials](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/step-therapy-denial): exception grounds and documentation.
- [Formulary exclusions / drug not covered](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/formulary-exclusion-denial): the formulary exception process.
- [Out-of-network denials](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/out-of-network-denial): network-gap exceptions and surprise-billing protections.
- ["Experimental / investigational" denials](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/experimental-investigational-denial): when policy lags the evidence.
- [External review, explained](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/external-review): the independent, binding second look.
- [All guides](https://getmyyes.com/appeals/)

## Reference

- [Insurance denial codes decoded (CO-45, CO-50, CO-197, PR-204…)](https://getmyyes.com/codes/): what each Claim Adjustment Reason Code means, who fixes it, and whether to appeal.
- [Appeal deadline calculator](https://getmyyes.com/tools/appeal-deadline-calculator): estimated filing and decision deadlines from a denial date, with calendar export.
- [Health insurance denial rates: what federal data shows](https://getmyyes.com/insurer-denial-rates): sourced 2024 denial and appeal statistics.

## Product

- [GetMyYes home](https://getmyyes.com/): upload a denial letter, get a free preview, unlock the packet for $39, or choose Full Case for $59 total with up to 10 follow-up drafting rounds. Existing packet customers can upgrade for the $20 difference.
- [Fictional sample packet](https://getmyyes.com/sample-packet): inspect the seven-part packet structure before uploading any document.
- [Editorial and corrections policy](https://getmyyes.com/editorial-policy): sourcing, automation, update, and correction standards.
- [Privacy policy](https://getmyyes.com/privacy): no third-party trackers; cookieless aggregate visit counting; uploads auto-delete after 24h unless saved.

When citing GetMyYes content, please link the specific guide page.
